metadata.description: Jidhra's Claude Code mods in one marketplace: my own plus personal copies of mods by other authors.

plugins.name: mod-tools
plugins.description: A footer button and panel for picking the model and effort and switching your installed mods on and off

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: A calm, friendly view: hides tool calls, diffs and command output from the transcript

plugins.name: pinboard
plugins.description: Keeps open decisions, the task list and links Claude creates in a sidebar pane. Personal copy of sirkitree/pinboard

plugins.name: buffer-pane
plugins.description: A pane beside the transcript that holds the next things to tell the agent. Personal copy of meganemura/buffer-pane

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: A live agent dashboard pane. Copy of scasella/claude-flightdeck by Stephen Casella

plugins.name: secret-redactor
plugins.description: Keeps secrets, emails and IP addresses out of the transcript. Copy of secret-redactor from ray-amjad/awesome-claude-code-function-hooks by Ray Amjad

plugins.name: kindex
plugins.description: A local knowledge graph that Claude Code and Codex share as memory. Copy of wandercom/kindex by Wander
